## LmdbJobRun.missed() method

Whether a scheduled occurrence passed since the last successful run.

**Signature:**

```typescript
missed(key: string, opts: IJobRunMissedOptions): boolean;
```

## Exceptions

[LmdbError](./lmdb.lmdberror.md) On a blank `key` or an unparseable `pattern`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Compares the persisted stamp against the most recent time `pattern` matched at or before `now`<!-- -->. `true` when the job never ran, or when that boundary is newer than the last success.

Use this to decide \*whether\* to run without committing to a schedule. To run on a pattern, use [LmdbJobRun.start()](./lmdb.lmdbjobrun.start.md)<!-- -->.
